# PT Arraya Mitra Informatika (ARRAYA)

> Perusahaan software dan solusi IT asal Indonesia. ARRAYA membangun sistem bisnis, platform AI, dan infrastruktur data untuk perusahaan dan pemerintah di Indonesia.

## Produk
- Jewelry Management: sistem manajemen toko emas & perhiasan end-to-end (POS/kasir, master stock puluhan ribu SKU, buyback, reparasi, DP, membership, integrasi WhatsApp, dashboard).
- Loge Knowledge AI: pencarian pengetahuan enterprise privat dengan sitasi sumber, konektor (Confluence, SharePoint, Google Drive, Jira, Slack, GitHub, Notion), AI agents, MCP actions.

## Layanan
- Electronic Signature (Tanda Tangan Elektronik)
- Microservice Management
- Data Warehouse System
- Custom Software Development (web & mobile)
- AI & Knowledge Solutions (RAG, enterprise search, AI agents)
- System Integration & Consulting
